data.one_liner: Add a focused long-press or tap menu to any Flutter widget.
data.what_it_does: Allows developers to wrap any widget with a focused menu holder that pops up a customized overlay menu on long press or tap. It supports customizable menu items, backgrounds, offsets, and animations.
use_when: You want to display a context menu when a user long-presses or taps a grid item or card.
You need custom animations and styling for popup menus.
avoid_when: You need native context menus specifically tailored to each platform's design guidelines.
strengths: Easy to implement by wrapping target widgets with FocusedMenuHolder.
Highly customizable including blur size, offsets, menu width, and item extent.
Supports opening with either long press or a simple tap.
weaknesses: Limited to popup menus triggered by touch or click interactions.
Not documented for complex accessibility features beyond basic widgets.
data.minimal_example:
FocusedMenuHolder(
  menuWidth: MediaQuery.of(context).size.width * 0.50,
  blurSize: 5.0,
  menuItemExtent: 45,
  menuItems: <FocusedMenuItem>[
    FocusedMenuItem(title: Text("Open"), trailingIcon: Icon(Icons.open_in_new), onPressed: () {}),
  ],
  onPressed: () {},
  child: Card(child: Text("Hold me")),
)
